description.description: Human-readable description of what the rule detects.

false-positive.description: Known false positive scenario for the rule.

from.description: Look-back window the rule searches from on each run (e.g. now-6m).

index.description: Index pattern(s) queried by the rule.

interval.description: Interval at which the rule is executed (e.g. 5m).

language.description: Query language used by the rule.

license.description: License applied to the detection rule.

max-signals.description: Maximum number of alerts the rule can create per execution.

mitre-attack-tactic.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic(s) associated with the rule.

mitre-attack-technique.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique(s) associated with the rule.

query.description: Query (KQL, Lucene, EQL, or ES|QL depending on language) implementing the detection.

reference.description: Reference URL for the rule source or documentation.

risk-score.description: Risk score assigned to the rule (0-100).

rule-id.description: Unique identifier of the rule (the rule_id UUID field in Elastic).

rule-name.description: Human-readable name of the detection rule.

tag.description: Free-text tag associated with the rule.

description: An object describing an Elastic Security detection rule (KQL/Lucene/EQL/ES|QL query), its scheduling, risk scoring, and MITRE ATT&CK mapping, following the Elastic detection-rules schema.
name: elastic-detection-rule
